ValidationRule.description: Freight - If no Parent Account is selected, user must choose either "Freight Forwarder", "Buyer", "Shipper", "Partner Airline", "GSA". If a Parent Account is selected, user must choose "Branch" as the Account Business Type.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
OR(AND( ISPICKVAL( New_Account_Type__c, "Freight-Branch") , NOT(ISBLANK(Parent_Account__c)), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Freight_Account_Business_Type__c , "Branch"))),
(AND( ISPICKVAL( New_Account_Type__c, "Freight-Branch"), ISBLANK(Parent_Account__c),OR(ISPICKVAL( Freight_Account_Business_Type__c , ""),ISPICKVAL( Freight_Account_Business_Type__c , "Branch")), NOT ( $Profile.Id = '00e90000001wK8z' ) /*system Administrator*/)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If Branch is selected as “Account Business Type”, please provide Parent Account Name (Country level Account)
